title: A live Global Configuration edit reaches the copy even when the sync's manifest names configuration.php without a hash; a listed file missing from a whole-tree read is named, never kept silently
expect: S1: a manifest entry without sha1 for configuration.php plus a live Site Name edit gives an incremental read packing configuration.php, the new name in changes/, a sha1 in the manifest after, no read on the next sync; a whole pack leaving a listed file out answers ok:false naming it

selectors.host: live-pull.mjs listCheap changed filter (f.unknown), whole-tree got/missing check; live_sync.py stat_manifest

fence: A change on the live site is never taken as unchanged because the site would not hash the file
